42	### Write Tool Does Not Persist Files
43	The `Write` tool was non-functional during this build (files appeared to write but did not exist on disk). All file creation must use `Bash cat > file << 'ENDOFFILE'` heredoc. Never use Write tool for new files in this environment.
44	
45	### DataState Pattern (Locked)
46	```tsx
47	// Correct usage for React Query components
48	<DataState
49	  data={data}                    // undefined = loading, null = empty, array = check .length
50	  isLoading={isLoading}
51	  isError={!!error}
52	  error={error instanceof Error ? error : null}
53	  loadingSlot={<TableSkeleton rows={N} />}  // always provide loadingSlot for known shapes
54	  emptySlot={<EmptyState icon={X} title="..." variant="first-time|no-results|default" />}
55	>
56	  {(d) => <YourContent data={d} />}
57	</DataState>
58	```
59	
60	### Filter Bars Above DataState
61	When a component has filter controls + data, keep the filter bar OUTSIDE DataState at the top. DataState wraps only the data-dependent area. This prevents filter controls from disappearing during loading.

64	`SaveIndicator` prop `lastSavedAt?: Date | null` — cannot pass `Date | undefined`, must be `Date | null`. Always use `null` for "no value" in optional props.

66	### `KpiRowSkeleton` Has No `cols` Prop
